annotations.title: Read a web page as clean text with links

description: Use when you need the text of a public web page (an article, docs page, listing): returns the title, visible text (up to 20,000 characters) and its links. Free, nothing stored. Example: {"url": "https://example.com/"}. Docs: https://llpro.ai/page-to-text
name: page_to_text
